nameFl:
IPEDS 2025-26 Import Specifications: Completions (Academic Year 2024-25)
Applies to: All Institutions
File type: Fixed Length/Positional (*.txt)
noteFL:
Note: If there were no awards conferred for a specific CIP code and award level during academic year 2024-25 but the institution still offers the program at that award level, submit a record (First major only) with the CIP code and award level with zeroes for CRACE01, CRACE02, CRACE13, CRACE14 and CRACE25 through CRACE38. All numeric fields should be right-justified in its field. Both leading zeros and spaces are permissible. Character data should be left justified.
Sort Order: UNITID,SURVSECT,PART,MAJORNUM

keyValueParts.title: Part A: Completions - CIP Data
keyValueParts.instruction: Note: Records with a count of zero should not be submitted, EXCEPT for cases where there were no awards conferred for a specific CIP code and award level during academic year 2024-25 but the institution still offers the program at that award level. In such cases, submit a record as follows: UNITID=nnnnnn,SURVSECT=COM,PART=A,MAJORNUM=1,CIPCODE=xx.xxxx,AWLEVEL=i,RACE=1,SEX=1,COUNT=0.
